title: Viewing Objects from the Front, Side and Top
seo_title: Grade 4 Viewing Objects Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Match different views of the same everyday objects; identify everyday objects from different views.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 4 viewing objects worksheets: top, front and side views of objects made of cubes, matching views and objects. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: Top view: looking down. Front view: looking from the front.
key_sub: A view shows only what you can see.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • An object looks different from different places.
  • The top view is what you see looking down from above.
  • The front view and side view are what you see from the front and from the side.
  • A view shows only what is facing you: cubes behind others are hidden.

Examples

Example

A row of 3 cubes with 1 cube on top of the left cube

front: 3 squares with 1 on the left above

Answer: an L shape

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Front or side?Check where the person is standing.
Hidden cubesA view shows only what you can see.
Two faces at onceA view shows one direction.

faq.q: What does CAPS Grade 4 say about viewing objects?
faq.a: Match different views of the same everyday objects, and identify everyday objects from different views.
Another name for the top view.
Maps, building plans and drawings use views.

faq.q: Can two objects have the same front view?
faq.a: Yes, so we need more than one view.
